title: 자기소개하기
subtitle: 학생 모임에서 처음 인사하기
summary_ko: 짧고 자연스럽게 자신을 소개하고 상대에게 질문을 되돌려보는 연습
user_goal_ko: 이름, 출신 또는 전공/직업, 취미를 소개하고 상대에게 질문하기
opening_line: Hi! I don't think we've met yet. I'm Emma from the club. What's your name?

stages.title: Start with your name
stages.hint_en: Say hello and tell your name.
stages.ai_prompt: Great to meet you. Tell me your name in one short sentence.
stages.redirect_question: Let's start with a simple introduction. What is your name?

stages.title: Share where you are from
stages.hint_en: Say where you are from or where you live.
stages.ai_prompt: Thanks. Where are you from?
stages.redirect_question: Back to the introduction. Where are you from?
stages.starter: I'm from ____.

stages.title: Talk about study or work
stages.hint_en: Mention your major, job, or what you study.
stages.ai_prompt: What do you study, or what do you do?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me one thing about your study or work.
stages.starter: I study ____.

stages.title: Add one hobby
stages.hint_en: Add one hobby or something you enjoy.
stages.ai_prompt: Nice. What do you like to do in your free time?
stages.redirect_question: Add one hobby to make your introduction fuller.
stages.starter: I like ____ in my free time.

stages.title: Ask a question back and close
stages.hint_en: Ask the other person a question and finish politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask me one question back, then close the conversation politely.
stages.redirect_question: Ask me a simple question like 'What about you?' and then say goodbye.
stages.starter: What about you?

title: 카페에서 주문하기
subtitle: 음료를 주문하고 옵션을 고르기
summary_ko: 기본 주문 표현, 옵션 선택, 결제 응답까지 이어지는 카페 대화 연습
user_goal_ko: 음료를 주문하고 사이즈, 온도, 추가 옵션, 결제 응답까지 완료하기
opening_line: Welcome! What can I get for you today?

stages.title: Order a drink
stages.hint_en: Say what drink or food you want.
stages.ai_prompt: Tell me your order clearly, please.
stages.redirect_question: Let's get back to your order. What would you like?
stages.starter: I'd like a latte, please.

stages.title: Choose a size
stages.hint_en: Choose small, medium, or large.
stages.ai_prompt: What size would you like?
stages.redirect_question: Please choose a size: small, medium, or large.
stages.starter: Medium, please.

stages.title: Say hot or iced
stages.hint_en: Say if you want it hot or iced.
stages.ai_prompt: Would you like it hot or iced?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me if you want it hot or iced.
stages.starter: I'd like it iced.

stages.title: Add one option
stages.hint_en: Add milk, sugar, syrup, or takeaway.
stages.ai_prompt: Any extra option, like milk, sugar, or takeaway?
stages.redirect_question: Add one option, for example extra shot, oat milk, or to go.
stages.starter: Oat milk, please.

stages.title: Respond to payment
stages.hint_en: Say how you will pay and close politely.
stages.ai_prompt: That will be five dollars. How would you like to pay?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me if you'll pay by card or cash, then close politely.
stages.starter: I'll pay by card. Thank you.

title: 길 묻기
subtitle: 목적지와 경로를 확인하기
summary_ko: 도움 요청부터 경로 확인, 감사 인사까지 이어지는 기본 길 찾기 대화 연습
user_goal_ko: 도움을 요청하고 목적지, 경로 확인, 감사 인사를 말하기
opening_line: Hi, you look a little lost. Can I help you?

stages.title: Ask for help
stages.hint_en: Ask politely for directions.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask me for directions politely.
stages.redirect_question: Start by asking for help, like 'Can you help me?'
stages.starter: Excuse me, can you help me?

stages.title: Say your destination
stages.hint_en: Say the place you want to go.
stages.ai_prompt: Where do you need to go?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me your destination, like the station or museum.
stages.starter: I'm trying to get to the subway station.

stages.title: Ask about the way
stages.hint_en: Ask how to get there or whether you can walk.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask how to get there.
stages.redirect_question: Ask me how to get there.
stages.starter: How do I get there?

stages.title: Repeat or confirm the route
stages.hint_en: Repeat the route or ask one checking question.
stages.ai_prompt: Repeat the route back to me, or ask one checking question.
stages.redirect_question: Confirm the route by saying left, right, straight, or asking a checking question.
stages.starter: So I go straight and then turn left, right?

stages.title: Thank and close
stages.hint_en: Say thank you and end politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Finish the conversation politely.
stages.redirect_question: End by thanking me politely.
stages.starter: Thank you so much. Have a nice day.

title: 가게에서 물건 사기
subtitle: 원하는 물건을 찾고 구매 결정하기
summary_ko: 상품 문의, 색상/사이즈, 가격, 구매 결정을 연습하는 쇼핑 대화
user_goal_ko: 찾는 물건과 원하는 조건을 말하고 구매를 마무리하기
opening_line: Hello! Can I help you find something today?

stages.title: Say what you need
stages.hint_en: Say what item you are looking for.
stages.ai_prompt: Tell me what you're looking for.
stages.redirect_question: Let's return to shopping. What item do you need?
stages.starter: I'm looking for a jacket.

stages.title: Add color or size
stages.hint_en: Say the color or size you want.
stages.ai_prompt: What color or size are you looking for?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me a color or size you want.
stages.starter: I'm looking for a black one in medium.

stages.title: Ask about the price
stages.hint_en: Ask how much it is.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask me about the price.
stages.redirect_question: Ask a simple question about the price.
stages.starter: How much is it?

stages.title: Ask to try it or check it
stages.hint_en: Ask to try it on or check the item.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask if you can try it on or take a closer look.
stages.redirect_question: Ask if you can try it on.
stages.starter: Can I try it on?

stages.title: Decide to buy and close
stages.hint_en: Say you will buy it and end politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Tell me if you want to buy it now.
stages.redirect_question: Finish by saying whether you'll buy it.
stages.starter: I'll take it. Thank you.

title: 호텔 체크인
subtitle: 예약 확인과 요청 사항 전달하기
summary_ko: 호텔 프런트에서 예약을 확인하고 추가 요청을 전달하는 중급 대화
user_goal_ko: 예약 정보 확인, 요청 사항, 편의시설 질문을 하고 체크인을 완료하기
opening_line: Good evening. Welcome to Riverfront Hotel. How can I help you today?

stages.title: State your reservation
stages.hint_en: Say you have a reservation and want to check in.
stages.ai_prompt: Please tell me about your reservation.
stages.redirect_question: Let's begin with your reservation. Are you checking in?
stages.starter: Hi, I have a reservation under Minji Kim, and I'd like to check in.

stages.title: Confirm dates or booking details
stages.hint_en: Confirm your dates, room type, or number of nights.
stages.ai_prompt: Please confirm your stay details.
stages.redirect_question: Tell me your dates or how many nights you're staying.
stages.starter: I'm staying for two nights from Friday to Sunday.

stages.title: Make one room request
stages.hint_en: Request a quiet room, higher floor, or late checkout.
stages.ai_prompt: Do you have any room requests?
stages.redirect_question: Please make one room request.
stages.starter: Could I have a quiet room on a higher floor if possible?

stages.title: Ask about hotel facilities
stages.hint_en: Ask one question about breakfast, Wi-Fi, or gym hours.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask me one question about the hotel facilities.
stages.redirect_question: Ask about breakfast, Wi-Fi, parking, or the gym.
stages.starter: Could you tell me what time breakfast starts?

stages.title: Wrap up the check-in
stages.hint_en: Thank the receptionist and close politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Finish the check-in politely.
stages.redirect_question: Close the check-in by thanking me politely.
stages.starter: Perfect, thank you for your help.

title: 공항 수하물 문제
subtitle: 분실 또는 지연된 수하물 신고하기
summary_ko: 공항 직원에게 수하물 문제를 신고하고 후속 절차를 확인하는 대화
user_goal_ko: 수하물 문제를 설명하고, 짐 특징과 연락처를 제공하고, 처리 절차를 확인하기
opening_line: Hello, this is the baggage service desk. How can I help you today?

stages.title: Report the problem
stages.hint_en: Say whether your bag is missing, delayed, or damaged.
stages.ai_prompt: Please describe your baggage issue.
stages.redirect_question: Let's focus on the baggage issue. Is your bag missing, delayed, or damaged?
stages.starter: My suitcase didn't arrive on the baggage belt.

stages.title: Give your flight details
stages.hint_en: Give your flight number or where you flew from.
stages.ai_prompt: Please give me your flight details.
stages.redirect_question: Tell me your flight number or departure city.
stages.starter: I arrived on flight KE123 from Tokyo this afternoon.

stages.title: Describe your bag
stages.hint_en: Describe the color, size, or brand of your bag.
stages.ai_prompt: Please describe your bag.
stages.redirect_question: Describe the color or size of your luggage.
stages.starter: It's a large black suitcase with a red luggage tag.

stages.title: Leave your contact information
stages.hint_en: Give a phone number, hotel, or address.
stages.ai_prompt: Please leave your contact information.
stages.redirect_question: Tell me where we can reach you.
stages.starter: You can reach me at 010-1234-5678, and I'm staying at the Sky Hotel.

stages.title: Ask about the next steps
stages.hint_en: Ask when the bag will arrive or what happens next.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask me what will happen next.
stages.redirect_question: Ask when you'll get your bag or how you'll be updated.
stages.starter: When do you think it will arrive, and how will you update me?

title: 병원 예약 문의
subtitle: 증상 설명과 예약 시간 조율하기
summary_ko: 병원에 전화해 증상, 기간, 가능한 시간대를 설명하고 예약을 확정하는 대화
user_goal_ko: 증상과 기간을 설명하고, 가능한 시간과 기본 정보를 전달해 예약을 확정하기
opening_line: Good afternoon, Green Family Clinic. How may I help you?

stages.title: Say why you need an appointment
stages.hint_en: State that you want an appointment and why.
stages.ai_prompt: Please tell me why you need an appointment.
stages.redirect_question: Let's begin with why you want to see a doctor.
stages.starter: I'd like to make an appointment because I've been feeling sick.

stages.title: Describe your symptoms
stages.hint_en: Describe one or two symptoms clearly.
stages.ai_prompt: What symptoms are you having?
stages.redirect_question: Describe your symptoms, such as fever, cough, or pain.
stages.starter: I have a sore throat and a mild fever.

stages.title: Say how long you've had it
stages.hint_en: Say how long the problem has lasted.
stages.ai_prompt: How long have you had these symptoms?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me how long you've felt this way.
stages.starter: I've had these symptoms for three days.

stages.title: Discuss available time
stages.hint_en: Say what day or time works for you.
stages.ai_prompt: What day or time works for you?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me when you're available.
stages.starter: Tomorrow afternoon would work best for me.

stages.title: Confirm personal details and close
stages.hint_en: Confirm your name, phone number, or insurance and close politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Please confirm one contact detail and finish the call politely.
stages.redirect_question: Leave one contact detail or insurance detail, then close politely.
stages.starter: My name is Jiyoon Park, and my phone number is 010-5555-3333. Thank you.

title: 업무 미팅 잡기
subtitle: 미팅 목적과 일정을 조율하기
summary_ko: 업무상 미팅 목적을 설명하고 대안을 제시하며 일정을 확정하는 대화
user_goal_ko: 미팅 목적, 일정 제안, 대안 협상, 안건 확인을 마무리하기
opening_line: Hi, I saw your message. What did you want to meet about?

stages.title: Explain the purpose
stages.hint_en: Explain why you want the meeting.
stages.ai_prompt: Tell me the purpose of the meeting.
stages.redirect_question: Let's start with the purpose of the meeting.
stages.starter: I'd like to meet to discuss the project timeline and next steps.

stages.title: Suggest a time
stages.hint_en: Suggest one concrete day and time.
stages.ai_prompt: Please suggest a meeting time.
stages.redirect_question: Give me one specific time suggestion.
stages.starter: Would Tuesday at 2 p.m. work for you?

stages.title: Offer an alternative
stages.hint_en: Offer a backup time if needed.
stages.ai_prompt: If that time doesn't work, give me another option.
stages.redirect_question: Offer one alternative time.
stages.starter: If not, I'm also free on Wednesday morning.

stages.title: Confirm the agenda
stages.hint_en: State what you want to cover in the meeting.
stages.ai_prompt: What exactly should we cover in the meeting?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me the key agenda items.
stages.starter: I'd like to cover the timeline, task owners, and the client update.

stages.title: Close the meeting arrangement
stages.hint_en: Confirm the time and end politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Wrap up the scheduling politely.
stages.redirect_question: Confirm the agreed time and end politely.
stages.starter: Great, let's meet on Wednesday at 10. Thanks for making time.

title: 식당 예약/컴플레인
subtitle: 문제를 제기하고 해결책을 협의하기
summary_ko: 식당에서 서비스 문제를 전문적이고 정중하게 제기하고 해결책을 협의하는 대화
user_goal_ko: 문제 상황을 설명하고 원하는 해결책을 제시해 합의를 도출하기
opening_line: Good evening. I'm the floor manager. I heard there was an issue with your table.

stages.title: Open with the issue
stages.hint_en: State the issue clearly and professionally.
stages.ai_prompt: Please explain what went wrong.
stages.redirect_question: Let's focus on the issue at the restaurant. What happened?
stages.starter: We had a reservation, but our food arrived very late and one dish was cold.

stages.title: Give supporting details
stages.hint_en: Add details like time, order, or impact.
stages.ai_prompt: Please give me a little more detail.
stages.redirect_question: Add one or two details so I can understand the problem.
stages.starter: We waited nearly forty minutes, and the steak was already cold when it arrived.

stages.title: State the resolution you want
stages.hint_en: Ask for a replacement, refund, or discount.
stages.ai_prompt: What would you like us to do to fix this?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me clearly what resolution you want.
stages.starter: I'd appreciate either a replacement dish or a discount on the bill.

stages.title: Respond to the manager's offer
stages.hint_en: Accept, reject, or refine the offer politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Respond to my offer and negotiate politely.
stages.redirect_question: Respond to the offer and explain what would be acceptable.
stages.starter: I appreciate that, but given the delay, a discount would be more appropriate.

stages.title: Close professionally
stages.hint_en: Confirm the agreement and close calmly.
stages.ai_prompt: Close the conversation professionally.
stages.redirect_question: Confirm the final agreement and end politely.
stages.starter: Thank you for resolving this. I appreciate your help.

title: 마감 일정 협상
subtitle: 지연 사유와 대안을 설명하고 합의하기
summary_ko: 업무상 마감 일정 지연 가능성을 설명하고 현실적인 대안을 협상하는 고급 대화
user_goal_ko: 리스크를 설명하고 새 일정과 범위를 제안한 뒤 실행 계획을 합의하기
opening_line: I saw your note about the project timeline. Can you walk me through the situation?

stages.title: Explain the project context
stages.hint_en: Briefly explain which project and deliverable you're discussing.
stages.ai_prompt: Please summarize the project situation.
stages.redirect_question: Let's focus on the project context first.
stages.starter: I'm calling about the client dashboard project and the reporting module due next Friday.

stages.title: Describe the risk or delay
stages.hint_en: Explain what is causing the delay.
stages.ai_prompt: What's causing the delay?
stages.redirect_question: Explain the main risk causing the delay.
stages.starter: We're behind because the data integration uncovered several blocking issues in the API.

stages.title: Propose a revised plan
stages.hint_en: Offer a realistic revised deadline or phased delivery.
stages.ai_prompt: What revised plan do you recommend?
stages.redirect_question: Propose a revised deadline or phased delivery plan.
stages.starter: I recommend delivering the core dashboard next Friday and the reporting module three days later.

stages.title: Negotiate scope or priorities
stages.hint_en: Explain what can stay in scope and what should move.
stages.ai_prompt: Which items should we prioritize or defer?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me what should be prioritized and what can move later.
stages.starter: If we prioritize the analytics view and defer export features, we can protect the main launch date.

stages.title: Close with action items
stages.hint_en: Summarize next steps, owners, or updates.
stages.ai_prompt: Please summarize the next actions.
stages.redirect_question: Close by summarizing next steps and follow-up.
stages.starter: I'll send an updated timeline today, and we'll review progress again on Wednesday.

title: 여권 분실 신고
subtitle: 긴급 상황을 설명하고 절차를 확인하기
summary_ko: 여권 분실 사실을 신고하고 신원, 일정, 긴급 발급 절차를 확인하는 대화
user_goal_ko: 분실 상황, 신원, 여행 일정, 긴급 발급 절차를 명확히 설명하고 확인하기
opening_line: This is the emergency consular desk. Please tell me what happened.

stages.title: Explain the loss
stages.hint_en: Explain when and where you lost your passport.
stages.ai_prompt: Please describe when and where the passport went missing.
stages.redirect_question: Let's focus on the passport incident. When and where did you lose it?
stages.starter: I think I lost my passport on the train from Paris to Brussels this morning.

stages.title: Confirm your identity
stages.hint_en: Give your name, nationality, and any ID you still have.
stages.ai_prompt: Please confirm your identity details.
stages.redirect_question: Tell me your name, nationality, or another ID you still have.
stages.starter: My name is Haejin Lee, I'm a Korean citizen, and I still have a copy of my driver's license.

stages.title: Explain your travel timeline
stages.hint_en: Explain your next trip or flight.
stages.ai_prompt: Please explain your upcoming travel plan.
stages.redirect_question: Tell me when you need to travel next.
stages.starter: I have a flight back to Seoul tomorrow evening, so I need an emergency document as soon as possible.

stages.title: Ask about the emergency procedure
stages.hint_en: Ask what documents and steps are required.
stages.ai_prompt: Ask me what documents and steps you need.
stages.redirect_question: Ask about the emergency document process.
stages.starter: Could you tell me what documents I need and how long the emergency travel certificate will take?

stages.title: Confirm the next step
stages.hint_en: Repeat the next step and close politely.
stages.ai_prompt: Please confirm the next step and close politely.
stages.redirect_question: Tell me what you will do next, then close politely.
stages.starter: Understood. I'll come to the consulate this afternoon with the required documents. Thank you for your guidance.

title: 성과 리뷰 면담
subtitle: 성과, 피드백, 지원 요청을 논의하기
summary_ko: 업무 성과를 정리하고 피드백에 응답하며 다음 분기 계획과 지원 요청을 협의하는 대화
user_goal_ko: 성과 사례, 개선 계획, 지원 요청, 다음 목표를 정리해 전문적으로 마무리하기
opening_line: Thanks for joining the review. I'd like to hear how you think this quarter went.

stages.title: Summarize your achievements
stages.hint_en: Highlight one or two concrete achievements.
stages.ai_prompt: Please summarize your strongest achievements this quarter.
stages.redirect_question: Let's begin with your key achievements this quarter.
stages.starter: This quarter, I led the onboarding redesign and reduced setup time by about thirty percent.

stages.title: Add evidence or impact
stages.hint_en: Add a number, example, or business impact.
stages.ai_prompt: Can you give me evidence or impact for that work?
stages.redirect_question: Add one example or measurable impact.
stages.starter: As a result, support tickets dropped significantly and new users reached activation faster.

stages.title: Respond to an area for improvement
stages.hint_en: Acknowledge feedback and explain your improvement plan.
stages.ai_prompt: Please respond to the feedback and explain how you'll improve.
stages.redirect_question: Address one improvement area and explain your plan.
stages.starter: I agree that I need to communicate earlier with stakeholders, and I'm already setting up weekly checkpoints to improve that.

stages.title: Ask for support
stages.hint_en: Request training, tools, staffing, or mentorship.
stages.ai_prompt: What support would help you improve further?
stages.redirect_question: Tell me what support would help you succeed next quarter.
stages.starter: It would help if I could get more direct access to analytics training and earlier feedback from cross-functional teams.

stages.title: Close with next-quarter goals
stages.hint_en: State your next-quarter goals and close professionally.
stages.ai_prompt: Please summarize your next-quarter goals and close the review.
stages.redirect_question: End by stating your next-quarter goals and thanking the manager.
stages.starter: Next quarter, I want to improve stakeholder alignment, mentor one junior teammate, and ship the retention dashboard on time. Thanks for the feedback today.
